workLog.action: Reproduced #3351 by writing a causal graph from nothing: load_causal_graph's empty graph omitted version and updated, both schema-required. The committed file kept them only because every write happened to load a file that already had them.
Fixed the empty graph to carry both fields and stamped updated on every write, so the schema holds on the path that had never run against the committed file.

Replaced sequential pattern ids with a content-derived id (#3353). Two branches each allocating the next number both produce p005 for different patterns, and the content-aware merge driver cannot tell them apart.

Identified five test seed rows in the production graph (#3352): node n001 and patterns p001 through p004, written by the retired reflexion_memory writer on 2026-02-10. No edge references n001 and no episode reproduces any of them, which is how they were found.
Removed the seed rows and corrected backfill_episode_provenance's docstring, which used the p001 fixture as its standing example of an unattributable record.
Added 173 lines of tests in tests/skills/memory/test_update_causal_graph.py covering metadata survival, id determinism, and merge-safety of the new id.
Regenerated the src/copilot-cli skill mirror and bumped both plugin manifests to keep the parity gate green.

patterns.pattern: Right-size the adr-review panel to the change surface and record omitted lenses
patterns.context: A pure reference-format ADR copy-edit has no security, data-model, or strategy surface.
patterns.application: Convene only the lenses with real surface (architect, critic), run them for real, and document in the debate log why the others were not convened, instead of producing empty six-agent verdicts.

avoidances.antipattern: Claiming a six-agent debate ran when it did not, to satisfy the gate
avoidances.consequence: Fabricated governance evidence that the pre-commit gate cannot detect but that violates the walk-or-do-not-name discipline.
avoidances.correction: Run the reviews that genuinely apply, verify their claims independently, and state the panel scope honestly in the artifact.
